verdict.rationale: The evidence covers founder-side equity paperwork: issuing founders' equity, customizing founder vesting, filing 83(b) elections, SAFEs, and incorporation templates built with Cooley. None of it mentions employee offer letters, confidentiality/IP assignment agreements, or option grants. Founder stock issuance and fundraising SAFEs are adjacent equity features, not the hiring and option-grant paperwork this story asks for.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I can run hiring and equity paperwork — offer letters, confidentiality/IP agreements, and option grants — through the platform
